```{r}
#| label: injury totals and proportions

totaldata <- totaldata |>
  mutate(totinjuries = Burn + CMF + Limb + NTD + `Soft Tissue` + `Wound Care`) |>
  mutate(burnprop = Burn / totinjuries) |>
  mutate(cmfprop = CMF / totinjuries) |>
  mutate(limbprop = Limb / totinjuries) |>
  mutate(ntdprop = NTD / totinjuries) |>
  mutate(stprop = `Soft Tissue` / totinjuries) |>
  mutate(wcprop = `Wound Care` / totinjuries)

totaldata <- totaldata |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace(., is.nan(.), 0)))

```

```{r}
#| label: total model
# Diagnostic + automatic-fix script
# Paste and run this in your R session

# ---- Setup (use your exact names) ----
attack_cols <- c("Air/drone strike","Ground Attacks",
                 "Shelling/artillery/missile attack","Civil Unrest","Other")
controls <- c("avg_distance_km","Percentage of Total Attacks","percent_total_area")
responses <- c("Burn","CMF","Limb","NTD","Soft Tissue","Wound Care")

safe_formula <- function(response, predictors) {
  lhs <- paste0("`", response, "`")
  rhs <- paste(paste0("`", predictors, "`"), collapse = " + ")
  as.formula(paste0(lhs, " ~ ", rhs))
}

td <- totaldata   # use your data

# Helper: print nicely
pmsg <- function(...) cat(sprintf(...), "\n")

# 1) Quick column checks -----------------------------------------------------
pmsg("1) Basic column checks:")
cols <- unique(c(attack_cols, controls, responses))
stopifnot(all(cols %in% colnames(td)))
# classes
print(sapply(cols, function(x) class(td[[x]])))
# ranges for numeric predictors, and unique counts for all
preds <- c(attack_cols, controls)
pmsg("Ranges (min, max) for numeric predictors and unique counts:")
for (nm in preds) {
  if (is.numeric(td[[nm]])) {
    rng <- range(td[[nm]], na.rm = TRUE)
    pmsg("  %s: range = [%g, %g], unique = %d", nm, rng[1], rng[2], length(unique(td[[nm]])))
  } else {
    pmsg("  %s: NOT numeric (class=%s), unique = %d", nm, class(td[[nm]]), length(unique(td[[nm]])))
  }
}

# 2) For each response: try model.matrix and basic diagnostics ----------------
diagnose_response <- function(resp) {
  pmsg("\n--- Diagnosing response: %s ---", resp)
  form <- safe_formula(resp, c(attack_cols, controls))
  pmsg("Formula: %s", deparse(form))
  mm <- tryCatch(model.matrix(form, data = td),
                 error = function(e) { pmsg("model.matrix() ERROR: %s", e$message); return(NULL) })
  if (is.null(mm)) return(list(ok=FALSE, reason="model.matrix error"))
  pmsg("model.matrix dims: %d rows x %d cols", nrow(mm), ncol(mm))
  # check finite
  if (!all(is.finite(mm))) {
    bad <- which(!is.finite(mm), arr.ind = TRUE)
    pmsg("Non-finite entries detected in model.matrix (showing up to 10):")
    print(head(bad, 10))
    badcols <- unique(bad[,2])
    pmsg("Problematic model-matrix columns: %s", paste(colnames(mm)[badcols], collapse = ", "))
    return(list(ok=FALSE, reason="model.matrix contains non-finite entries", badcols = colnames(mm)[badcols]))
  } else {
    pmsg("All entries in model.matrix are finite.")
  }
  # rank
  qrinfo <- qr(mm)
  pmsg("QR rank = %d  (ncol = %d)", qrinfo$rank, ncol(mm))
  if (qrinfo$rank < ncol(mm)) {
    pmsg(" -> Rank-deficient model matrix detected (perfect multicollinearity). Running alias() on lm to show combos...")
    ali <- tryCatch(alias(lm(form, data = td)), error = function(e) { pmsg("alias() error: %s", e$message); NULL })
    print(ali)
    return(list(ok=FALSE, reason="rank-deficient", alias=ali))
  }
  return(list(ok=TRUE, mm=mm))
}

diag_results <- lapply(responses, diagnose_response)
names(diag_results) <- responses

# 3) Try single-predictor glm's to find which predictor causes fitting failure ----
pmsg("\n2) Single-predictor Poisson fits (to isolate bad predictor).")
single_try <- function(resp, pred) {
  form <- safe_formula(resp, pred)
  res <- tryCatch({
    m <- glm(form, data = td, family = poisson(link="log"), control = glm.control(maxit=50, epsilon=1e-8))
    list(ok=TRUE, model=m)
  }, warning = function(w) {
    list(ok="warning", msg=w$message)
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(ok=FALSE, msg=e$message)
  })
  res
}

single_map <- list()
for (r in responses) {
  pmsg("\nResponse = %s", r)
  single_map[[r]] <- lapply(c(attack_cols, controls), function(p) {
    res <- single_try(r, p)
    if (isTRUE(res$ok)) {
      pmsg("  Predictor %-40s -> OK", p)
      "ok"
    } else {
      pmsg("  Predictor %-40s -> %s", p, paste0(res$ok, ": ", if(!is.null(res$msg)) res$msg else ""))
      paste0(res$ok, ": ", if(!is.null(res$msg)) res$msg else "")
    }
  })
  names(single_map[[r]]) <- c(attack_cols, controls)
}

# 4) If full models failed, try scaled predictors (standardize) ----------------
pmsg("\n3) Attempt fitting full models with scaled predictors (scale helps numeric stability).")
td_scaled <- td
for (nm in c(attack_cols, controls)) {
  if (is.numeric(td_scaled[[nm]])) {
    td_scaled[[nm]] <- as.numeric(scale(td_scaled[[nm]]))
  } else {
    # try coercion
    td_scaled[[nm]] <- as.numeric(as.character(td_scaled[[nm]]))
  }
}

fit_full <- function(resp, data_df) {
  form <- safe_formula(resp, c(attack_cols, controls))
  fit <- tryCatch({
    glm(form, data=data_df, family=poisson(link="log"), control = glm.control(maxit=100))
  }, warning = function(w) {
    # still return the model if it exists with a warning
    list(warning=w$message, model=NULL)
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(error=e$message, model=NULL)
  })
  fit
}

scaled_fits <- lapply(responses, function(r) fit_full(r, td_scaled))
names(scaled_fits) <- responses

# report which scaled fits succeeded
for (r in responses) {
  f <- scaled_fits[[r]]
  if (inherits(f, "glm")) {
    pmsg("Scaled fit for %s: OK (glm)", r)
  } else if (is.list(f) && !is.null(f$error)) {
    pmsg("Scaled fit for %s: ERROR: %s", r, f$error)
  } else if (is.list(f) && !is.null(f$warning)) {
    pmsg("Scaled fit for %s: WARNING during fit: %s", r, f$warning)
  } else {
    pmsg("Scaled fit for %s: unknown result", r)
  }
}

# 5) Systematic predictor removal: drop one predictor at a time and try full fit ----
pmsg("\n4) Systematic single-predictor-removal trials to locate culprit(s).")
full_fit_with_removed <- function(resp, remove_pred=NULL, data_df=td) {
  preds <- setdiff(c(attack_cols, controls), remove_pred)
  form <- safe_formula(resp, preds)
  tryCatch({
    glm(form, data = data_df, family = poisson(link="log"), control = glm.control(maxit=100))
  }, error = function(e) e$message)
}

removal_results <- list()
for (r in responses) {
  pmsg("\nResponse: %s", r)
  base_attempt <- tryFit <- tryCatch(glm(safe_formula(r, c(attack_cols, controls)), data = td,
                                        family = poisson(link="log"), control = glm.control(maxit=50)),
                                    error = function(e) e$message, warning = function(w) w$message)
  if (inherits(base_attempt, "glm")) {
    pmsg("  Full model without removals: succeeded (no removal needed).")
    removal_results[[r]] <- list(full_ok=TRUE)
    next
  } else {
    pmsg("  Full model failed (message: %s). Trying removals...", substr(as.character(base_attempt),1,200))
  }
  rr <- sapply(c(attack_cols, controls), function(p) {
    msg <- full_fit_with_removed(r, remove_pred = p, data_df = td)
    ok <- inherits(msg, "glm")
    if (ok) {
      pmsg("    Removing %-45s -> fit OK", p)
      TRUE
    } else {
      pmsg("    Removing %-45s -> still fails: %s", p, substr(as.character(msg),1,120))
      FALSE
    }
    ok
  })
  removal_results[[r]] <- rr
}

# 6) Fallback: try quasi-Poisson or increase glm control (often more stable) ----
pmsg("\n5) Fallback attempts (quasi-Poisson & increased iterations) for previously failing responses.")
fallback_results <- list()
for (r in responses) {
  pmsg("\nResponse: %s", r)
  # try quasi-Poisson
  qfit <- tryCatch(glm(safe_formula(r, c(attack_cols, controls)), data = td,
                       family = quasipoisson(link="log"), control = glm.control(maxit=200)),
                   error = function(e) e$message, warning = function(w) w$message)
  fallback_results[[r]] <- list(quasi = qfit)
  if (inherits(qfit, "glm")) pmsg("  quasi-Poisson: OK")
  else pmsg("  quasi-Poisson: failed / message: %s", substr(as.character(qfit),1,200))
}

# Summary report --------------------------------------------------------------
pmsg("\n===== SUMMARY =====")
pmsg("Diagnostic results per response (model.matrix ok?):")
for (r in responses) {
  ok <- diag_results[[r]]$ok
  pmsg("  %s : model.matrix OK? %s", r, ifelse(isTRUE(ok), "YES", paste0("NO -> ", diag_results[[r]]$reason)))
}
pmsg("Single-predictor map (first few):")
print(lapply(single_map, function(x) head(unlist(x), 6)))
pmsg("Scaled-fit success (which responses had an actual glm object):")
print(sapply(scaled_fits, function(f) inherits(f, "glm")))

pmsg("\nIf any response succeeded when predictors were scaled, try re-running the analysis using scaled predictors (scale(...) or log1p + scale).")
pmsg("If removing a particular predictor made the fit succeed, that predictor is likely causing collinearity or separation; consider combining it (PCA) or dropping one of the correlated ones.")
pmsg("If quasi-Poisson fit succeeded, overdispersion or numeric instability is likely — quasi-Poisson is sometimes more stable than NB when NB fails to converge.")
pmsg("\nSaved diagnostics in variables: diag_results, single_map, scaled_fits, removal_results, fallback_results")

```
